transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, it's my knees. Both of them have been hurting for several years now, but it's gotten a lot worse over the last few months. It's really starting to get in the way of my daily activities.
Could you tell me about any medicines you take, and any allergies or bad reactions you've had to medicines?

For the knees, I've been taking anti-inflammatory medicines, and I've also had cortisone injections and Synvisc injections in them. I don't have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines that I know of.
Have you ever had any operations?
No, I haven't had any operations. That's actually part of why I'm here — I want to know whether something like surgery could help my knees.
Besides the pain in your knees, have you noticed any other symptoms or changes in how you feel?
No, nothing else that I've noticed. It's really just the knee pain that's been troubling me.
What kinds of things seem to make your knee pain better or worse?
The medicines and injections did help, but only temporarily — the relief never lasted. Beyond that, I can't say I've noticed anything specific that makes it better or worse.
Could you describe how bad your knee pain gets and how it affects your daily life?

It's gotten bad enough that it's affecting my daily activities — just getting around and doing the things I normally do has become difficult. It's been steadily worsening over the last few months, which is why I'm here.
Is there anything else from your past health — like other health problems, illnesses, or hospital stays — that you’d like to add?
No, I can't think of anything else. Apart from the knees, I've been fairly healthy.
What does the pain in your knees feel like?
I'm not sure how to describe it beyond just being painful — a sore, aching pain in both knees. I can't really put it any more specifically than that.
What medicines are you taking these days — including any that are new or have been changed recently?
I take anti-inflammatory medicines for the knees. Nothing new or changed recently that I can think of — it's been the same for a while now.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
